name: Dynamic Diffuse Global Illumination (DDGI)
aliases: DDGI (Discrete Deep Gathers / Dynamic Depth Global Illumination)
definition: A Global Illumination technique using a 3D grid array of very low resolution cubemaps (e.g., 4x4), built using raytracing or cone tracing, with a second depth cubemap to prevent light/shadow leaks.
summary: DDGI is a real-time global illumination technique that computes one-bounce diffuse indirect lighting using a 3D grid of low-resolution cubemap probes, eliminating light and shadow leaks inherent in voxel-based methods.
